name: com.crisphive/mcp
description: Field operations on a deterministic solver — run jobs, crews & fleet from Claude or ChatGPT.

environmentVariables.name: CRISPHIVE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Crisphive Developer API key (chsk_live_... = production data, chsk_test_... = isolated sandbox). Create one in the dashboard under Developers -> API keys.

environmentVariables.name: CRISPHIVE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API origin override. Defaults to https://api.crisphive.com.
